svg.title: E02 GEMINI HELIX engineering architecture
svg.desc: Attitude, acoustics and approved endpoints share timing but retain distinct validity gates. External aiding constrains position, and acoustic/dose outputs remain unavailable when calibration or observation quality is absent.
